_comment: tools/release/push_repo.tscn: `message` is the commit message (it falls back to a release-tidy message if blank), `check_tag` is a release tag it checks is still live after pushing ("" skips the check).
message:
Realistic Mixamo zombies (D-112) and buildings out of the streets (D-111)

The five open-world zombie types now use realistic Mixamo characters with retargeted
Mixamo animations (scream, grab, crawl, stand-up, twitch and stumble loaded for the scare
work). The Mixamo files are gitignored - their licence forbids sharing the raw files - and
every Mixamo model falls back to the CC0 one when they are missing. The map importer now
builds roads first and drops building footprints that stand in a street; cells re-baked.
